question: What should I do if the freezer temperature is above the acceptable range?
expected_answer: Verify the reading with a calibrated probe thermometer placed in the center of the freezer, and confirm the door is closed, the seal is intact, and the unit is plugged in. Wait 15 minutes and check again. If it is still above 0°F, keep the door closed, move items that are still frozen solid to a working freezer, label any thawing items HOLD - DO NOT USE, and discard anything that has been above 41°F for more than 4 hours. Record both readings, the time, the actions taken, and your initials on the Freezer Temperature Log. Notify the shift manager immediately.

question: What temperature should the refrigerators be kept at?
expected_answer: Refrigerators must stay between 33°F and 41°F. Check and record each refrigerator temperature at opening, at mid-shift, and at closing on the Refrigerator Temperature Log. If a reading is above 41°F, verify it with a calibrated probe thermometer and check again after 15 minutes. If it is below 33°F, adjust the thermostat one setting warmer and check again in 30 minutes.

question: What should I do if the power goes out during my shift?
expected_answer: Stop taking new orders and finish only the orders that can be completed safely. Keep refrigerator and freezer doors closed. Record the time the power went out and notify the shift manager. When power returns, check and record all refrigerator and freezer temperatures, and follow Food Storage Safety before using food from any unit that is out of range.

question: A guest says they have a nut allergy. How should I make their drink?
expected_answer: Repeat the allergy back to the guest to confirm it and mark the order ALLERGY in the point-of-sale system. Wash your hands and put on new gloves. Use a clean pitcher, a clean blender jar, and washed and sanitized utensils, including the purple-handled tools for nut-free orders. If you are unsure whether an ingredient contains nuts, tell the guest and notify the shift manager. Hand the drink to the guest directly and confirm the allergy again.

question: How do I clean the espresso machine at closing?
expected_answer: Remove the portafilters and rinse them in hot water. Insert a blind basket, add one scoop of espresso machine cleaner, and run the backflush cycle five times, then run it five more times with water only. Purge and wipe each steam wand, wipe the group heads, and empty and rinse the drip tray. Record the cleaning on the Equipment Cleaning Log.
